hero.heading: Building digital products that feel useful and human.
hero.introduction: Hi, I am Nyakio Christine. I am a software engineer who enjoys building things end to end from clean user interfaces to reliable backend services and data-driven features.

about: I’ve contributed across frontend, backend, and cloud, and I’m comfortable picking up whatever tools a problem needs.

What matters most to me is building useful products: writing readable code, designing simple systems, and improving things iteratively based on real usage. I’m especially interested in scalable web applications, and product-focused engineering.
I enjoy working with small, collaborative teams, asking good questions, and turning ambiguous ideas into working software. Always learning, always curious.
